name: Demo_Create_OBJ_BITMAP_LABEL_EA
summary: This EA demonstrates how to create and manage an OBJ_BITMAP_LABEL object on a MetaTrader 5 chart. It creates a bitmap button with two image states (pressed/unpressed) using BMP files, and deletes the object on deinitialization. It does not execute any trades or implement a trading strategy.
summary_zh: 该EA演示了如何在MetaTrader 5图表上创建和管理OBJ_BITMAP_LABEL对象。它使用BMP文件创建一个具有两种图像状态（按下/未按下）的位图按钮，并在去初始化时删除该对象。它不执行任何交易或实现任何交易策略。
strategy_analysis: 该EA并非交易策略EA，而是一个图表对象创建的演示工具。它没有任何入场条件、出场条件、仓位管理或资金管理逻辑。策略概念仅仅是展示如何在MQL5中通过编程方式创建OBJ_BITMAP_LABEL类型的图形对象，并为该对象设置属性如锚点角落、X/Y偏移距离以及按下和未按下状态的位图文件路径。代码在OnInit中创建对象并加载两张BMP图片分别作为按下和未按下状态的显示，在OnDeinit中删除图表对象以保持清洁。没有任何交易信号生成、订单管理或风险控制机制。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a trading strategy but a demonstration utility for creating chart objects in MQL5. There are no entry conditions, exit conditions, position sizing, or money management logic whatsoever. The strategy concept is purely to demonstrate how to programmatically create an OBJ_BITMAP_LABEL graphical object on a chart, set its properties such as anchor corner, X/Y offset distances, and bitmap file paths for pressed and unpressed states. The code creates the object in OnInit, loads two BMP images for the two button states, and deletes the chart object in OnDeinit for cleanup. No trading signals, order management, or risk control mechanisms exist in this code.

pros: 代码简洁明了，适合初学者学习OBJ_BITMAP_LABEL对象的创建方法
包含错误处理逻辑，在图片加载失败时会输出错误代码
在OnDeinit中正确清理图表对象，避免残留
使用ResetLastError和GetLastError进行错误诊断，便于调试
pros_en: Clean and concise code, suitable for beginners learning OBJ_BITMAP_LABEL object creation
Includes error handling that outputs error codes when image loading fails
Properly cleans up chart objects in OnDeinit to prevent leftover artifacts
Uses ResetLastError and GetLastError for error diagnostics, aiding debugging
cons: 仅作为演示代码，无任何实际交易功能或策略逻辑
没有检查BMP文件是否存在，仅在加载失败后报错而非预防
缺少对象属性验证和状态管理，按钮点击后无任何响应逻辑
硬编码的图片路径和坐标值，缺乏灵活性和可配置性
cons_en: Only a demo code with no actual trading functionality or strategy logic
No preemptive check for BMP file existence, only reports errors after failure
Missing object property validation and state management; no click response logic
Hardcoded image paths and coordinate values, lacking flexibility and configurability
improvements: 添加OnChartEvent处理函数，响应按钮点击事件以实现交互功能
将图片路径和坐标参数外部化，通过输入参数让用户自定义配置
improvements_en: Add an OnChartEvent handler to respond to button click events for interactive functionality
Externalize image paths and coordinates as input parameters for user customization

risk_points: 不涉及任何交易操作，无金融风险
图片文件路径硬编码，若文件缺失仅影响显示效果
risk_points_en: No trading operations involved, no financial risk
Hardcoded image file paths; missing files only affect display
